faithful.test: max |output(explained model) - output(phenotype)| over the training rows < 1e-9

decomposed.test: share of hidden units whose part is at most 6 units wide (depth not penalised); no part wider than that holds half the units

understood.test: understood_mike: the share of leaves graded understood by Mike's leaf verdict (the measured level; None until a leaf has one). author.note: the concept the explaining agent stored on each leaf (set_meaning), re-probed under the v2 simplicity and support conditions; None when no concept was stored
